lead_raw_text:
The structure of SrAs₃ (Sr₂As₆ per cell) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 8 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows As centers with 8 neighbors (4 As, 4 Sr) and Sr centers with 10 neighbors (4 As, 6 Sr), while another As orbit has 6 neighbors (4 As, 2 Sr). These environments span 3- and 4-vertex geometric coordination polyhedra, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among As and Sr polyhedra, forming a 3-dimensional connectivity network.
